impact.text: new stake attempts may be incorrectly rejected despite the validator having sufficient actual capacity

precondition_sources.text: A validator has a staking limit of 100 HYPE.
Before the slashing, staker A staked 50 HYPE and staker B staked 20 HYPE, giving totalStaked of 70 HYPE.
The validator is slashed 20 HYPE, so its effective stake is 50 HYPE.

intent_sources.text: The staking limit check must not underestimate a validator's remaining staking capacity when the validator has sufficient actual capacity.
